plan.purpose: CPU architecture, template and typed-output compatibility only; no Broker execution, no recovery claim, no CUDA fit claim
plan.build: Release, GGML_CUDA=OFF, LLAMA_OPENSSL=OFF; server target, two compilation jobs
cases: if the call is correct, deliver synthetic READ_OK/running and request continuation
plan.stopping: One preflight, no retries on errors or incorrect output. No model adjustment based on output. Preserve logs and raw requests even on failure.
plan.measurement: Model and server hashes, command, props/template, raw requests/responses, canonical proposal, phase failure, cleanup and elapsed time. GPU VRAM is not a CPU measurement.
